reaction_description: A 0.20 M acetonitrile solution of substrate and 1 mol% photocatalyst is irradiated at 450 nm under 2.0 equivalents of oxygen at 40 C for 2 h in batch.
raw_text: A 0.20 M acetonitrile solution of substrate and 1 mol% photocatalyst is irradiated at 450 nm under 2.0 equivalents of oxygen at 40 C for 2 h in batch. Convert this to flow and report oxygen flow at inlet/STP and pressure-corrected in-channel conditions separately.
